description: Paid ($0.01 via x402 in USDC on Base, Solana, Algorand or Stellar, or in RLUSD on the XRP Ledger): diagnose an x402 endpoint the way a paying agent would, without paying it: the 402 challenge format, every accepts[] option, the resource URL, Solana settlement readiness, which wallets can pay, Bazaar/OpenAPI discovery and the browser paywall. Returns every check with pass/warn/fail and a fix hint. For the endpoint's owner or a developer debugging it; to decide whether to pay someone else's endpoint, use x402_preflight. Same as GET /api/v1/diagnose. The answer carries a signed receipt (EIP-191, bound to your arguments) that proves later which verdict you got.

body.description: Example JSON request body, for a POST route that checks its input before the 402 (implies POST). Without it, {} is sent and the requestBody example in the endpoint's /openapi.json is tried.

method.description: HTTP method of the paid route (default: GET, then POST)

url.description: The x402 endpoint (public http(s) URL), e.g. https://api.example.com/paid

name: x402_diagnose

accepts.description: Only on an unpaid call: the x402 payment options

checks.description: Every check with its status, message and hint

overall.description: pass, warn or fail (absent on the payment requirement)

receipt.description: Signed receipt (EIP-191) binding the answer to your arguments

title: Diagnose an x402 endpoint ($0.01 via x402)
